messages:
Sahil: Heads up  deal desk flagged: PO 900211 stuck in AP because partner used their local merchant (they're asking Redwood to accept invoice under partner merchant instead of marketplace MO). Close window is Thursday, need to decide.
AP-bot: Invoice 2024-1021 status: MERCHANT_MISMATCH. PO 900211 expects merchant_of_record=redwood-marketplace but invoice from merchant_id=EDGE-UK-MERCH. HOLD flagged.
Nina: Partner (Edge Distribution Ltd) says their ERP automatically invoices under their merchant account for tax reasons. They don’t want to onboard to Redwood marketplace now. Sales wants to accommodate to not lose deal.
Tom: Quick checklist: 1) merchant mismatch affects tax treatment and remit-to banking. 2) vendor must be in vendor master or we need a manual alias mapping + indemnity. 3) GL allocation may change if merchant not Redwood MO.
Legal: We can sign a limited acceptance letter but need partner to accept indemnity and confirm VAT/EORI/registration numbers. Also need clause: exception is one-off and Redwood not liable for partner tax reporting.
Sahil: Can AP process payment to partner merchant if we create a vendor record today? What's the timeline?
AP-bot: Creating new vendor record requires vendor onboarding docs: legal name, tax id, bank details, signed W-8/W-9 or W-8BEN-E. Manual vendor creation can be done same day if docs are attached to ticket. Ticket created: AP-TICKET-9344.
Nina: Partner says they have VAT cert and bank details but won’t share W-8 because they’re non-US and provide W-8BEN-E only to customers. They asked if Redwood can accept their signed vendor questionnaire instead.
Legal: W-8BEN-E is standard. We can accept partner questionnaire only if it contains equivalent tax certs and signed statement under penalties of perjury. Prefer original W-8.
PartnerBot: EdgeDist: we will provide VAT cert + bank proof. We can sign Redwood exception memo but can only produce W-8BEN-E after month end (in 6 business days).
Tom: If W-8BEN-E arrives late, we can do a conditional payment but must put a tax reserve for potential withholding and require partner to indemnify. Finance needs estimate of exposure.
CFO: Estimate tax exposure: likely 5-25% depending on jurisdiction. Need a holdback formula: suggest 25% reserve escrow until docs validated. Approve conditional payment with 25% holdback and signed indemnity.
Sahil: Sales will eat some holdback but not all. Any chance to process net 75% today and hold 25% pending docs?
Legal: Draft short memo: "Redwood will process payment of 75% of invoice as a one-time exception. Partner warrants tax status and will provide W-8BEN-E within 7 business days. Partner indemnifies Redwood for any taxes, penalties, or withholdings; Redwood will retain 25% until validation." Keep signature blocks.
AP-bot: AP-TICKET-9344 updated: awaiting signed indemnity and VAT + bank docs. Status: pending-vendor-docs.
Nina: I'll ask partner to sign and send VAT + bank proof now; ask to confirm they can provide W-8BEN-E within 7 business days. Looping partner contact.
PartnerBot: EdgeDist: will sign indemnity and share VAT + bank proof today, W-8BEN-E in 7 business days. Requesting 75% release today.
CFO: Approve conditional release at 75% once indemnity and VAT + bank proof received and legal approves memo. Finance to set reserve entry GL 2100 (payable hold).
Sahil: Action items: Nina to collect docs and upload to AP-TICKET-9344; Legal to finalize memo and get partner signature; AP to prepare payment at 75% on receipt of docs. Deadline: EOD tomorrow.
Tom: Noted. If docs don't arrive by deadline we revert to no-pay and push for full onboarding.
AP-bot: Escalation: ESC-1209 treasury-conditional-payment created.
Sahil: Thanks team  please update ticket and ping me on any blocker.
CFO: Will monitor.
Legal: Posting memo draft here for sign-off: "Redwood processes 75% payment as exception; partner to provide W-8BEN-E within 7 business days; partner indemnifies Redwood for any tax liabilities; 25% withheld until validation."
Nina: Partner signed and sent VAT cert + bank proof at 10:42. Uploading to AP ticket.
AP-bot: AP-TICKET-9344 status: docs-received. Payment scheduled today for 75% pending treasury clearance.
Sahil: Closing loop  will update CRM and revenue ops once payment posts.
PartnerBot: EdgeDist: thanks, will send W-8BEN-E in 6 business days.
Tom: Marking SUPPORT-3555 resolved for now; reopen if W-8 not received.
